Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body:
Seems like a dumb question to ask and I feel like I really should know the answer, but what the hell...

Are Archons stackable? Nothing on the card suggests that you can't have multiple on the same vampire, so if so, does an opposing vamp pay one blood per Archon, or one blood regardless of the amount of Archons? The same goes for Camarilla Exemplary, I guess, but what happens when you combine them on the same vampire?

> Archon
> Type: Political Action
> Requires: prince,justicar
> Requires a prince or justicar.
> Choose a Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire. This vampire may enter combat with a vampire controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth  action. Any vampire attempting to block this vampire burns 1 blood. Blood hunts cannot be called on this vampire. Any Camarilla vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
>
Rarity: Jyhad:V VTES:V CE:U KMW:PAl3
>
> Camarilla Exemplary
> Type: Political Action
> Requires: camarilla
> Requires a Camarilla vampire.
> Choose a Camarilla vampire. Successful referendum means that for the remainder of the game, any vampire attempting to block that vampire burns 1 blood.
>
> Rarity: Jyhad:C VTES:C CE:C/PV2
>

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Kiddo wrote:
> Seems like a dumb question to ask and I feel like I really should know the answer, but what the hell...
>
> Are Archons stackable?
>
Yes.
>
> Kiddo wrote:
> Nothing on the card suggests that you can't have multiple on the same vampire, so if so, does an opposing vamp pay one blood per Archon, or one blood regardless of the amount of Archons? The same goes for Camarilla Exemplary, I guess, but what happens when you combine them on the same vampire?
>
Vampires attempting to block the Archon burn 1 blood per Archon (or Camarilla Exemplary) on him.

Same goes for Aching Beauty.
